data.name: PROMOTER: The Fight Game
data.detailed_description:
PROMOTER: The Fight Game is a deep sports management simulation where you build a boxing promotional company from nothing into a global powerhouse. Scout raw talent from the amateurs and free-agent pools. Sign them. Promote them. Match them carefully, too soon, and you wreck a career, too late and a rival promoter swoops in. Book the venues. Sell the narrative. Fill the arena. Watch the money come in or not.

BUILD YOUR PROMOTION

Business comes first, loyalty after

Start in local venues with unknown fighters and limited cash. Grow your company into a worldwide powerhouse capable of selling out arenas and dominating the boxing industry.

  • Sign fighters, managers, trainers, and staff

  • Discover amateur talent before rival promoters do

  • Develop regional, national, and global promotions

  • Build relationships with broadcasters and sponsors

  • Manage finances, debt, and operational costs

EMERGENT STORYTELLING

No scripted campaign. No predetermined narratives.

Every save in PROMOTER: The Fight Game generates unique stories shaped by your decisions, fighter personalities, business politics, and the unpredictable nature of combat sports.

  • A hyped prospect can collapse under pressure.

  • A journeyman can shock the world.

  • A bitter rivalry can define an entire era.

  • A controversial decision can spark outrage across the sport.

  • Champions rise. Rival promoters wage cold wars behind the scenes. Media narratives influence public opinion and fighter popularity. Careers can be built slowly over years or destroyed overnight.

  • The world evolves whether you succeed or fail.

  • No two careers, promotions, or boxing worlds will ever unfold the same way.

FIGHT NIGHT IS THE PAYOFF

Promote events ranging from small local cards to historic mega-fights.

Choose venues, undercards, production quality, marketing spend, pacing, and matchmaking strategy. A poorly constructed card can hurt your reputation. A legendary event can define an era.

  • Build complete fight cards

  • Balance entertainment vs profitability

  • Create rivalries and long-term narratives

  • Handle late pullouts, controversies, and injuries

  • Simulated fight results driven by fighter styles, preparation, and matchmaking

RUN THE BUSINESS, NOT JUST THE ROSTER

Boxing is politics, money, and manipulation.

Negotiate contracts with demanding fighters and ruthless managers. Handle purse splits, rematch clauses, sponsorship demands, injuries, and failed negotiations. Decide whether to protect your prospects carefully… or throw them into dangerous fights for a payday.

  • Dynamic contract negotiations

  • Sanctioning body politics and rankings

  • PPV revenue and ticket pricing

  • Media obligations and public perception

  • Rival promoters competing for talent

  • Fighter morale, loyalty, and career expectations

A LIVING BOXING WORLD

The world moves with or without you.

Rival promotions sign talent. Champions duck contenders. Prospects fail. Unknown underdogs become legends. Media narratives influence popularity and negotiations. The sport evolves over decades.

No two saves develop the same way.

FULLY MODDABLE

Shape the boxing world however you want.

PROMOTER: The Fight Game is designed with modding support at its core, allowing players to customise and expand nearly every aspect of the game.

Create:

  • Custom fighters and promoters

  • New organisations and championships

  • Alternate eras and historical databases

  • Custom logos, graphics, and branding

Whether you want a modern boxing simulation, a fictional combat sports universe, or a completely chaotic alternate history of the sport, the tools are in your hands.

FEATURES

  • Deep promotional business simulation: contracts, finances, sponsorships, broadcast deals

  • Broadcast-caliber fight night presentation: tale of the tape, weigh-ins, live scorecards

  • No scripted campaign: every save generates its own careers and rivalries

  • A living world of rival promoters and hundreds of fighters that keeps moving whether you're winning or not

  • Full modding support: custom fighters, promotions, championships, and databases

data.short_description: The Football Manager of boxing. Build your promotional empire from nothing, scout fighters, negotiate contracts, sell the fights, and outmanoeuvre rival promoters in a fully simulated world. You're not the fighter. You're the power behind them

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (Quad-core, 3.2 GHz+)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD RX 470 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X (6–8 cores, 3.8 GHz+)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 5500 XT (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card

data.legal_notice:
All fighters, managers, promotions, sanctioning bodies, organisations, and events depicted in this game are fictional. Any resemblance to real persons, organisations, or events is unintentional.

PROMOTER: The Fight Game supports user-generated content and modding, including the import of third-party assets, artwork, and logos. Mods are created by the community and are not reviewed, endorsed, or controlled by Langa Publishing Limited. Players are solely responsible for ensuring any content they create or import does not infringe on the rights of others. Use of mods is at the player's own risk.
